name: Cutshort
notes: Pricing page lists a Freedom plan priced by company size, with unlimited job postings included. An Assisted model charges 8.33% of CTC on a successful hire. Free evaluation API keys can be generated after the account is approved. Footer link 'Find engineering talent via API/MCP' points to a page; /api returned HTTP 404 so no API documentation URL was recorded. No language switcher or partner program found. Eval API keys are generated by approved employers in Settings. Production access is requested by email, and production keys add job posting. The pricing page describes Freedom plans and an Assisted model. No headquarters, parent, language switcher or partner program found.

review.note: Pricing, developer docs, About and homepage read; API keys and pricing stated, no HQ or partner program.
